verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents server-side sensitive-data management tools to redact/remove sensitive data retroactively for GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA compliance, and its SDKs are known to support event-usage filtering controls, but the evidence pack does not explicitly describe SDK-level filtering callbacks (e.g. onError redaction before send) or confirm data never persists prior to scrubbing. missing for 10: explicit SDK-level pre-send filtering/redaction documentation, confirmation that scrubbing happens before persistence (vs. retroactive removal), independent verification of scrubbing efficacy.
